relations.name: demo_ledger_backfill_readiness_v1
relations.view_definition:
SELECT id AS operation_id,
    request_id,
    amount_cents,
        CASE
            WHEN kind <> 'transfer'::text THEN 'not_transfer'::text
            WHEN amount_cents <= 0 OR source_user_id IS NULL OR destination_user_id IS NULL OR source_user_id = destination_user_id THEN 'invalid'::text
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM mwd_finance_private.ledger_transactions t
              WHERE t.external_reference = ('mwd-demo-transfer:'::text || o.id::text))) THEN 'already_in_ledger'::text
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM mwd_operations x
              WHERE x.id <> o.id AND x.request_id = o.request_id AND x.kind = 'transfer'::text)) THEN 'duplicate_request_review'::text
            ELSE 'ready_for_backfill'::text
        END AS readiness
   FROM mwd_operations o
  WHERE kind = 'transfer'::text;

relations.name: demo_operations_audit_v1
relations.view_definition:
SELECT id AS operation_id,
    kind,
    created_at,
    amount_cents,
        CASE
            WHEN amount_cents <= 0 OR actor_id IS NULL OR request_id IS NULL THEN 'invalid_basic'::text
            WHEN kind = 'transfer'::text AND (source_user_id IS NULL OR destination_user_id IS NULL OR source_user_id = destination_user_id) THEN 'invalid_transfer'::text
            WHEN kind = 'transfer'::text THEN 'transfer_ready_for_ledger'::text
            WHEN kind = 'contribution'::text THEN 'contribution_requires_accounting_policy'::text
            ELSE 'unsupported_kind'::text
        END AS audit_status
   FROM mwd_operations o;

relations.name: demo_transfer_reconciliation_v1
relations.view_definition:
SELECT id AS operation_id,
    created_at,
    amount_cents,
    source_user_id,
    destination_user_id,
        CASE
            WHEN source_user_id IS NOT NULL AND destination_user_id IS NOT NULL AND source_user_id <> destination_user_id AND amount_cents > 0 THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS structurally_valid,
    amount_cents AS debit_cents,
    amount_cents AS credit_cents,
    amount_cents - amount_cents AS difference_cents
   FROM mwd_operations o
  WHERE kind = 'transfer'::text;

relations.name: demo_wallet_alerts_v1
relations.view_definition:
SELECT user_id,
    balance_cents,
    net_recorded_cents,
    implied_opening_cents,
    difference_from_default_cents,
        CASE
            WHEN difference_from_default_cents <> 0 THEN 'balance_mismatch'::text
            ELSE 'ok'::text
        END AS alert_status
   FROM mwd_finance_private.demo_wallet_opening_audit_v1;

relations.name: demo_wallet_opening_audit_v1
relations.view_definition:
SELECT user_id,
    balance_cents,
    net_recorded_cents,
    implied_opening_cents,
    1000000::bigint AS configured_default_opening_cents,
    implied_opening_cents - 1000000 AS difference_from_default_cents,
        CASE
            WHEN implied_opening_cents = 1000000 THEN 'matches_configured_default'::text
            ELSE 'review_required'::text
        END AS audit_status
   FROM mwd_finance_private.demo_wallet_reconciliation_v1 r;

relations.name: demo_wallet_reconciliation_v1
relations.view_definition:
WITH movement AS (
         SELECT mwd_operations.source_user_id AS user_id,
            - mwd_operations.amount_cents AS delta
           FROM mwd_operations
          WHERE mwd_operations.kind = 'transfer'::text AND mwd_operations.source_user_id IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT mwd_operations.destination_user_id,
            mwd_operations.amount_cents
           FROM mwd_operations
          WHERE mwd_operations.kind = 'transfer'::text AND mwd_operations.destination_user_id IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT mwd_operations.source_user_id,
            - mwd_operations.amount_cents
           FROM mwd_operations
          WHERE mwd_operations.kind = 'contribution'::text AND mwd_operations.source_user_id IS NOT NULL
        ), totals AS (
         SELECT movement.user_id,
            sum(movement.delta)::bigint AS net_recorded_cents
           FROM movement
          GROUP BY movement.user_id
        )
 SELECT w.user_id,
    w.balance_cents,
    COALESCE(t.net_recorded_cents, 0::bigint) AS net_recorded_cents,
    w.balance_cents - COALESCE(t.net_recorded_cents, 0::bigint) AS implied_opening_cents,
    'opening_balance_not_independently_verified'::text AS reconciliation_status
   FROM mwd_wallets w
     LEFT JOIN totals t ON t.user_id = w.user_id;

relations.name: ledger_balance_check
relations.view_definition:
SELECT t.id AS transaction_id,
    t.status,
    t.currency_code,
    COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN e.entry_side = 'debit'::text THEN e.amount_minor
            ELSE 0::bigint
        END), 0::numeric) AS total_debits,
    COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN e.entry_side = 'credit'::text THEN e.amount_minor
            ELSE 0::bigint
        END), 0::numeric) AS total_credits,
    count(e.id) AS entry_count
   FROM mwd_finance_private.ledger_transactions t
     LEFT JOIN mwd_finance_private.ledger_entries e ON e.transaction_id = t.id
  GROUP BY t.id, t.status, t.currency_code;

functions.name: enforce_posted_balance
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mwd_finance_private.enforce_posted_balance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ DECLARE v_debits numeric; v_credits numeric; v_count bigint; BEGIN IF OLD.status='posted' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Una transaccion contabilizada no puede modificarse'; END IF; IF NEW.status='posted' THEN SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE entry_side='debit'),0), COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor) FILTER (WHERE entry_side='credit'),0),COUNT(*) INTO v_debits,v_credits,v_count FROM mwd_finance_private.ledger_entries WHERE transaction_id=NEW.id; IF v_count<2 OR v_debits=0 OR v_debits<>v_credits THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Asiento no equilibrado'; END IF; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$

functions.name: post_demo_transfer_ledger_v1
protect_posted_entries
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mwd_finance_private.protect_posted_entries()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ DECLARE v_status text; BEGIN SELECT status INTO v_status FROM mwd_finance_private.ledger_transactions WHERE id=COALESCE(NEW.transaction_id,OLD.transaction_id) FOR UPDATE; IF v_status='posted' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'No se pueden modificar asientos contabilizados'; END IF; IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NEW.transaction_id<>OLD.transaction_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'No se permite mover un asiento entre transacciones'; END IF; IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$

functions.name: protect_posted_transactions
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mwd_finance_private.protect_posted_transactions()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ BEGIN IF OLD.status='posted' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'No se puede eliminar o modificar una transaccion contabilizada'; END IF; IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; IF NEW.id<>OLD.id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'No se puede cambiar el identificador de una transaccion'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$

functions.name: mwd_owner_accounting_alerts_demo
mwd_pending_recipient_check_demo
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mwd_pending_recipient_check_demo(p_request_id uuid, p_recipient_code text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ declare v_actor uuid := auth.uid(); v_operation public.mwd_operations%rowtype; v_exists boolean; begin if v_actor is null then raise exception 'Se requiere sesion autenticada' using errcode='42501'; end if; if p_request_id is null or p_recipient_code is null or p_recipient_code !~ '^MWD-[A-F0-9]{16}$' then raise exception 'Referencia invalida' using errcode='22023'; end if; select * into v_operation from public.mwd_operations where actor_id=v_actor and request_id=p_request_id; if found then return jsonb_build_object('status','processed','operationId',v_operation.id); end if; select exists(select 1 from public.mwd_wallets where account_code=p_recipient_code) into v_exists; if not v_exists then return jsonb_build_object('status','invalid_recipient'); end if; return jsonb_build_object('status','unconfirmed'); end $function$
